reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness tool that reports Git branch tracking and bounded staged, unstaged, conflicted, and untracked path status without providing repository mutation operations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读的 Git 工作区快照，显示分支跟踪信息以及暂存、未暂存、冲突和未跟踪路径状态。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a read-only Git workspace snapshot covering branch tracking and staged, unstaged, conflicted, and untracked path status.

capabilities: Reads Git repository branch tracking and path status
Invokes a bounded Git status subprocess
Returns structured workspace metadata to the model
